summary.text: Rob Yundt is a Republican member of the Alaska State Senate for District N, serving in the 2025-2026 legislature.

paragraphs.text: According to the Alaska Legislature's member page, he has served on the Matanuska-Susitna Borough Assembly, including as deputy mayor, and has worked in residential home construction and residential asset management.
The page lists his education as Wasilla High School and his residence as Wasilla, and says he is a past president of the Alaska State Homebuilder's Association.
